description: Read the latest entries from any public RSS/Atom feed URL or auto-discovered website feed. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

url.description: RSS/Atom feed URL or page URL that advertises one (http/https)
